1.text: In tha third year of tha reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon 2 Jerusalem, N besieged it.

N tha Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah in2 his hand, wit part of tha vessels of tha house of God: which he carried in2 tha land of Shinar 2 tha house of his god; N he brought tha vessels in2 tha treasure house of his god.
N tha king spoke 2 Ashpenaz tha master of his eunuchs, dat he should bring certain of tha children of Israel, N of tha king’s seed, N of tha princes;

Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, N skilful in all wisdom, N cunning in knowledge, N understanding science, N such as had ability in ’em 2 stand in tha king’s palace, N whom dey might teach tha learning N tha tongue of tha Chaldeans.
N tha king appointed ’em a daily provision of tha king’s food, N of tha wine which he drank: so nourishing ’em three years, dat at tha end of it dey might stand before tha king.
Now among dese were of tha children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, N Azariah:
2 whom tha prince of tha eunuchs gave namez: 4 he gave 2 Daniel tha name of Belteshazzar; N 2 Hananiah, of Shadrach; N 2 Mishael, of Meshach; N 2 Azariah, of Abed-nego.

But Daniel purposed in his heart dat he would not defile himself wit tha portion of tha king’s food, nor wit tha wine which he drank: therefore he requested of tha prince of tha eunuchs dat he might not defile himself.
Now God had brought Daniel in2 favour N tender love wit tha prince of tha eunuchs.

N tha prince of tha eunuchs said 2 Daniel, I fear my lord tha king, who has appointed ur food N ur drink: 4 why should he see ur faces worse liking than tha children which r of ur sort? then shall y’all make me endanger my head 2 tha king.
Then said Daniel 2 Melzar, whom tha prince of tha eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, N Azariah,
Prove ur servants, I beg u, ten days; N let ’em give us pulse 2 eat, N water 2 drink.
Then let our countenances be looked upon before u, N tha countenance of tha children dat eat of tha portion of tha king’s food: N as u see, deal wit ur servants.
So he consented 2 ’em in dis matter, N proved ’em ten days.
N at tha end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer N fatter in flesh than all tha children which did eat tha portion of tha king’s food.
Like dis Melzar took away tha portion of their food, N tha wine dat dey should drink; N gave ’em pulse.
As 4 dese four children, God gave ’em knowledge N skill in all learning N wisdom: N Daniel had understanding in all visions N dreams.
Now at tha end of tha days dat tha king had said he should bring ’em in, then tha prince of tha eunuchs brought ’em in before Nebuchadnezzar.
N tha king communed wit ’em; N among ’em all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, N Azariah: therefore stood dey before tha king.
N in all matters of wisdom N understanding, dat tha king enquired of ’em, he found ’em ten times better than all tha magicians N astrologers dat were in all his realm.
N Daniel continued even 2 tha first year of king Cyrus.

2.text: N in tha second year of tha reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, N his sleep broke from him.
Then tha king commanded 2 call tha magicians, N tha astrologers, N tha sorcerers, N tha Chaldeans, 4 2 show tha king his dreams. So dey came N stood before tha king.
N tha king said 2 ’em, I have dreamed a dream, N my spirit was troubled 2 know tha dream.
Then spoke tha Chaldeans 2 tha king in Syriack, O king, live 4 ever: tell ur servants tha dream, N we will show tha interpretation.

Tha king answered 2 tha Chaldeans, tha thing is gone from me: if y’all will not make known 2 me tha dream, wit tha interpretation of it, y’all shall be cut in pieces, N ur houses shall be made a dunghill.
But if y’all show tha dream, N tha interpretation of it, y’all shall receive of me gifts N rewards N great honour: therefore show me tha dream, N tha interpretation of it.
Dey answered again N said, Let tha king tell his servants tha dream, N we will show tha interpretation of it.
Tha king answered, I know of certainty dat y’all would gain tha time, because y’all see tha thing is gone from me.

But if y’all will not make known 2 me tha dream, there is but one decree 4 u: 4 y’all have prepared lyin N corrupt words 2 speak before me, till tha time be changed: therefore tell me tha dream, N I shall know dat y’all can show me tha interpretation of it.

Tha Chaldeans answered before tha king, N said, There is not a man upon tha earth dat can show tha king’s matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, dat asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
N it is a rare thing dat tha king requireth, N there is none other dat can show it before tha king, except tha gods, whose livin is not wit flesh.
4 dis cause tha king was angry N very furious, N commanded 2 destroy all tha wise men of Babylon.
N tha decree went forth dat tha wise men should be killed; N dey sought Daniel N his fellows 2 be killed.
Then Daniel answered wit counsel N wisdom 2 Arioch tha captain of tha king’s guard, which was gone forth 2 kill tha wise men of Babylon:
He answered 2 Arioch tha king’s captain, Why is tha decree so hasty from tha king? Then Arioch made tha thing known 2 Daniel.
Then Daniel went in, N desired of tha king dat he would give him time, N dat he would show tha king tha interpretation.
Then Daniel went 2 his house, N made tha thing known 2 Hananiah, Mishael, N Azariah, his companions:
Dat dey would desire mercies of tha God of heaven concerning dis secret; dat Daniel N his fellows should not perish wit tha rest of tha wise men of Babylon.
Then was tha secret revealed 2 Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed tha God of heaven.
Daniel answered, Blessed be tha name of God 4 ever N ever: 4 wisdom N might r his:
N he changeth tha times N tha seasons: he removeth kings, N sets up kings: he gives wisdom 2 tha wise, N knowledge 2 ’em dat know understanding:
He reveals tha deep N secret things: he knows what is in tha darkness, N tha light lives wit him.
I thank u, N praise u, O u God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom N might, N have made known 2 me now what we desired of u: 4 u have now made known 2 us tha king’s matter.

Therefore Daniel went in 2 Arioch, whom tha king had ordained 2 destroy tha wise men of Babylon: he went N said like dis 2 him; Destroy not tha wise men of Babylon: bring me in before tha king, N I will show 2 tha king tha interpretation.
Then Arioch brought in Daniel before tha king in haste, N said like dis 2 him, I have found a man of tha captives of Judah, dat will make known 2 tha king tha interpretation.
Tha king answered 2 Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, r u able 2 make known 2 me tha dream which I have seen, N tha interpretation of it?
Daniel answered in tha presence of tha king, N said, tha secret which tha king has demanded cannot tha wise men, tha astrologers, tha magicians, tha soothsayers, show 2 tha king;
But there is a God in heaven dat reveals secrets, N makes known 2 tha king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in tha latter days. ur dream, N tha visions of ur head upon ur bed, r dese;
As 4 u, O king, ur thoughts came in2 ur mind upon ur bed, what should come 2 pass hereafter: N he dat reveals secrets makes known 2 u what shall come 2 pass.

But as 4 me, dis secret is not revealed 2 me 4 any wisdom dat I have more than any livin, but 4 their sakes dat shall make known tha interpretation 2 tha king, N dat u might know tha thoughts of ur heart.
u, O king, saw, N look a great image. dis great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before u; N tha form of it was terrible.
Dis image’s head was of fine gold, his breast N his arms of silver, his belly N his thighs of brass,
His legs of iron, his feet part of iron N part of clay.
u saw till dat a stone was cut out without hands, which struck tha image upon his feet dat were of iron N clay, N broke ’em 2 pieces.

Then was tha iron, tha clay, tha brass, tha silver, N tha gold, broken 2 pieces together, N became like tha chaff of tha summer threshingfloors; N tha wind carried ’em away, dat no place was found 4 ’em: N tha stone dat struck tha image became a great mountain, N filled tha whole earth.
Dis is tha dream; N we will tell tha interpretation of it before tha king.
u, O king, art a king of kings: 4 tha God of heaven has given u a kingdom, power, N strength, N glory.
N wherever tha children of men live, tha beasts of tha field N tha fowls of tha heaven has he given in2 thine hand, N has made u ruler over ’em all. u r dis head of gold.
N after u shall arise another kingdom inferior 2 u, N another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all tha earth.
N tha fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaks in pieces N subdueth all things: N as iron dat breaks all dese, shall it break in pieces N bruise.

N whereas u saw tha feet N toes, part of potters’ clay, N part of iron, tha kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of tha strength of tha iron, forasmuch as u saw tha iron mixed wit miry clay.
N as tha toes of tha feet were part of iron, N part of clay, so tha kingdom shall be partly strong, N partly broken.
N whereas u saw iron mixed wit miry clay, dey shall mingle themselves wit tha seed of men: but dey shall not cleave one 2 another, even as iron is not mixed wit clay.

N in tha days of dese kings shall tha God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: N tha kingdom shall not be left 2 other people, but it shall break in pieces N consume all dese kingdoms, N it shall stand 4 ever.

Forasmuch as u saw dat tha stone was cut out of tha mountain without hands, N dat it broke in pieces tha iron, tha brass, tha clay, tha silver, N tha gold; tha great God has made known 2 tha king what shall come 2 pass hereafter: N tha dream is certain, N tha interpretation of it sure.
Then tha king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, N worshipped Daniel, N commanded dat dey should offer an oblation N sweet odours 2 him.
Tha king answered 2 Daniel, N said, Of a truth it is, dat ur God is a God of gods, N a Lord of kings, N a revealer of secrets, seein u could reveal dis secret.
Then tha king made Daniel a great man, N gave him many great gifts, N made him ruler over tha whole province of Babylon, N chief of tha governors over all tha wise men of Babylon.
Then Daniel requested of tha king, N he set Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, over tha affairs of tha province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in tha gate of tha king.

3.text: Nebuchadnezzar tha king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, N tha breadth of it six cubits: he set it up in tha plain of Dura, in tha province of Babylon.

Then Nebuchadnezzar tha king sent 2 gather together tha princes, tha governors, N tha captains, tha judges, tha treasurers, tha counsellors, tha sheriffs, N all tha rulers of tha provinces, 2 come 2 tha dedication of tha image which Nebuchadnezzar tha king had set up.

Then tha princes, tha governors, N captains, tha judges, tha treasurers, tha counsellors, tha sheriffs, N all tha rulers of tha provinces, were gathered together 2 tha dedication of tha image dat Nebuchadnezzar tha king had set up; N dey stood before tha image dat Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
Then an herald cried aloud, 2 u it is commanded, O people, nations, N languages,

Dat at what time y’all hear tha sound of tha cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, N all kinds of musick, y’all fall down N worship tha golden image dat Nebuchadnezzar tha king has set up:
N whoever falls not down N worships shall tha same hour be cast in2 tha midst of a burnin fiery furnace.

Therefore at dat time, when all tha people heard tha sound of tha cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, N all kinds of musick, all tha people, tha nations, N tha languages, fell down N worshipped tha golden image dat Nebuchadnezzar tha king had set up.
So at dat time certain Chaldeans came near, N accused tha Jews.
Dey spoke N said 2 tha king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live 4 ever.
u, O king, have made a decree, dat every man dat shall hear tha sound of tha cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, N dulcimer, N all kinds of musick, shall fall down N worship tha golden image:
N whoever falls not down N worships, dat he should be cast in2 tha midst of a burnin fiery furnace.

There r certain Jews whom u have set over tha affairs of tha province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego; dese men, O king, have not regarded u: dey serve not ur gods, nor worship tha golden image which u have set up.
Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage N fury commanded 2 bring Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego. Then dey brought dese men before tha king.
Nebuchadnezzar spoke N said 2 ’em, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, do not y’all serve my gods, nor worship tha golden image which I have set up?

Now if y’all be ready dat at what time y’all hear tha sound of tha cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, N dulcimer, N all kinds of musick, y’all fall down N worship tha image which I have made; well: but if y’all worship not, y’all shall be cast tha same hour in2 tha midst of a burnin fiery furnace; N who is dat God dat shall deliver u out of my hands?
Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, answered 2 tha king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we r not careful 2 answer u in dis matter.
If it be so, our God whom we serve is able 2 deliver us from tha burnin fiery furnace, N he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
But if not, be it known 2 u, O king, dat we will not serve ur gods, nor worship tha golden image which u have set up.

Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, N tha form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego: therefore he spoke, N commanded dat dey should heat tha furnace one seven times more than it was wont 2 be heated.
N he commanded tha most mighty men dat were in his army 2 bind Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, N 2 cast ’em in2 tha burnin fiery furnace.
Then dese men were bound in their coats, their hosen, N their hats, N their other garments, N were cast in2 tha midst of tha burnin fiery furnace.
Therefore because tha king’s commandment was urgent, N tha furnace exceeding hot, tha flame of tha fire killed dose men dat took up Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego.
N dese three men, Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, fell down bound in2 tha midst of tha burnin fiery furnace.
Then Nebuchadnezzar tha king was astonied, N rose up in haste, N spoke, N said 2 his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound in2 tha midst of tha fire? dey answered 2 tha king, True, O king.
He answered, look, I see four men loose, walkin in tha midst of tha fire, N dey have no hurt; N tha form of tha fourth is like tha Son of God.

Then Nebuchadnezzar came near 2 tha mouth of tha burnin fiery furnace, N spoke, N said, Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, y’all servants of tha most high God, come forth, N come here. Then Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, came forth of tha midst of tha fire.

N tha princes, governors, N captains, N tha king’s counsellors, bein gathered together, saw dese men, upon whose bodies tha fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor tha smell of fire had passed on ’em.

Then Nebuchadnezzar spoke, N said, Blessed be tha God of Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, who has sent his angel, N delivered his servants dat trusted in him, N have changed tha king’s word, N yielded their bodies, dat dey might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

Therefore I make a decree, dat every people, nation, N language, which speak any thing amiss against tha God of Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, N their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God dat can deliver after dis sort.
Then tha king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, N Abed-nego, in tha province of Babylon.

4.text: Nebuchadnezzar tha king, 2 all people, nations, N languages, dat live in all tha earth; Peace be multiplied 2 u.
I thought it good 2 show tha signs N wonders dat tha high God has wrought toward me.
How great r his signs! N how mighty r his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, N his dominion is from generation 2 generation.
I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, N flourishing in my palace:
I saw a dream which made me afraid, N tha thoughts upon my bed N tha visions of my head troubled me.
Therefore made I a decree 2 bring in all tha wise men of Babylon before me, dat dey might make known 2 me tha interpretation of tha dream.
Then came in tha magicians, tha astrologers, tha Chaldeans, N tha soothsayers: N I told tha dream before ’em; but dey did not make known 2 me tha interpretation of it.
But at tha last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according 2 tha name of my god, N in whom is tha spirit of tha holy gods: N before him I told tha dream, sayin,
O Belteshazzar, master of tha magicians, because I know dat tha spirit of tha holy gods is in u, N no secret troubles u, tell me tha visions of my dream dat I have seen, N tha interpretation of it.
Like dis were tha visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, N look a tree in tha midst of tha earth, N tha height of it was great.
Tha tree grew, N was strong, N tha height of it reached 2 heaven, N tha sight of it 2 tha end of all tha earth:

Tha leaves of it were fair, N tha fruit of it much, N in it was food 4 all: tha beasts of tha field had shadow under it, N tha fowls of tha heaven lived in tha boughs of it, N all flesh was fed of it.
I saw in tha visions of my head upon my bed, N, look, a watcher N an holy one came down from heaven;
He cried aloud, N said like dis, Hew down tha tree, N cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, N scatter his fruit: let tha beasts get away from under it, N tha fowls from his branches:

Nevertheless leave tha stump of his roots in tha earth, even wit a band of iron N brass, in tha tender grass of tha field; N let it be wet wit tha dew of heaven, N let his portion be wit tha beasts in tha grass of tha earth:
Let his heart be changed from man’s, N let a beast’s heart be given 2 him; N let seven times pass over him.

Dis matter is by tha decree of tha watchers, N tha demand by tha word of tha holy ones: 2 tha intent dat tha livin may know dat tha most High rules in tha kingdom of men, N gives it 2 whoever he will, N sets up over it tha basest of men.

Dis dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now u, O Belteshazzar, declare tha interpretation of it, forasmuch as all tha wise men of my kingdom r not able 2 make known 2 me tha interpretation: but u r able; 4 tha spirit of tha holy gods is in u.

Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied 4 one hour, N his thoughts troubled him. tha king spoke, N said, Belteshazzar, don’t let tha dream, or tha interpretation of it, trouble u. Belteshazzar answered, My lord, tha dream be 2 ’em dat hate u, N tha interpretation of it 2 thine opps.
Tha tree dat u saw, which grew, N was strong, whose height reached 2 tha heaven, N tha sight of it 2 all tha earth;
Whose leaves were fair, N tha fruit of it much, N in it was food 4 all; under which tha beasts of tha field lived, N upon whose branches tha fowls of tha heaven had their habitation:
It is u, O king, dat art grown N become strong: 4 ur greatness is grown, N reaches 2 heaven, N ur dominion 2 tha end of tha earth.

N whereas tha king saw a watcher N an holy one comin down from heaven, N sayin, Hew tha tree down, N destroy it; yet leave tha stump of tha roots of it in tha earth, even wit a band of iron N brass, in tha tender grass of tha field; N let it be wet wit tha dew of heaven, N let his portion be wit tha beasts of tha field, till seven times pass over him;
Dis is tha interpretation, O king, N dis is tha decree of tha most High, which is come upon my lord tha king:

Dat dey shall drive u from men, N ur livin shall be wit tha beasts of tha field, N dey shall make u 2 eat grass as oxen, N dey shall wet u wit tha dew of heaven, N seven times shall pass over u, till u know dat tha most High rules in tha kingdom of men, N gives it 2 whoever he will.
N whereas dey commanded 2 leave tha stump of tha tree roots; ur kingdom shall be sure 2 u, after dat u will have known dat tha heavenz do rule.
So, O king, let my counsel be acceptable 2 u, N break off ur sins by righteousness, N thine iniquities by shewing mercy 2 tha poor; if it may be a lengthening of ur tranquillity.
All dis came upon tha king Nebuchadnezzar.
At tha end of twelve months he walked in tha palace of tha kingdom of Babylon.
Tha king spoke, N said, Is not dis great Babylon, dat I have built 4 tha house of tha kingdom by tha might of my power, N 4 tha honour of my majesty?
While tha word was in tha king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, sayin, O king Nebuchadnezzar, 2 u it is spoken; tha kingdom is departed from u.

N dey shall drive u from men, N ur livin shall be wit tha beasts of tha field: dey shall make u 2 eat grass as oxen, N seven times shall pass over u, until u know dat tha most High rules in tha kingdom of men, N gives it 2 whoever he will.

Tha same hour was tha thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: N he was driven from men, N did eat grass as oxen, N his body was wet wit tha dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles’ feathers, N his nails like birds’ claws.

N at tha end of tha days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up my eyes 2 heaven, N mine understanding returned 2 me, N I blessed tha most High, N I praised N honoured him dat lives 4 ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, N his kingdom is from generation 2 generation:
N all tha inhabitants of tha earth r reputed as nothing: N he does according 2 his will in tha army of heaven, N among tha inhabitants of tha earth: N none can stay his hand, or say 2 him, What do u?

At tha same time my reason returned 2 me; N 4 tha glory of my kingdom, mine honour N brightness returned 2 me; N my counsellors N my lords sought 2 me; N I was established in my kingdom, N excellent majesty was added 2 me.
Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise N extol N honour tha King of heaven, all whose works r truth, N his ways judgment: N dose dat walk in pride he is able 2 abase.

5.text: Belshazzar tha king made a great feast 2 a thousand of his lords, N drank wine before tha thousand.

Belshazzar, whiles he tasted tha wine, commanded 2 bring tha golden N silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of tha temple which was in Jerusalem; dat tha king, N his princes, his wives, N his concubines, might drink in it.
Then dey brought tha golden vessels dat were taken out of tha temple of tha house of God which was at Jerusalem; N tha king, N his princes, his wives, N his concubines, drank in ’em.
Dey drank wine, N praised tha gods of gold, N of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, N of stone.
In tha same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, N wrote over against tha candlestick upon tha plaister of tha wall of tha king’s palace: N tha king saw tha part of tha hand dat wrote.
Then tha king’s countenance was changed, N his thoughts troubled him, so dat tha joints of his loins were loosed, N his knees struck one against another.

Tha king cried aloud 2 bring in tha astrologers, tha Chaldeans, N tha soothsayers. N tha king spoke, N said 2 tha wise men of Babylon, whoever shall read dis writing, N show me tha interpretation of it, shall be clothed wit scarlet, N have a chain of gold about his neck, N shall be tha third ruler in tha kingdom.
Then came in all tha king’s wise men: but dey could not read tha writing, nor make known 2 tha king tha interpretation of it.
Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, N his countenance was changed in him, N his lords were astonied.

Now tha queen, by reason of tha words of tha king N his lords, came in2 tha banquet house: N tha queen spoke N said, O king, live 4 ever: don’t let ur thoughts trouble u, nor let ur countenance be changed:

There is a man in ur kingdom, in whom is tha spirit of tha holy gods; N in tha days of ur father light N understanding N wisdom, like tha wisdom of tha gods, was found in him; whom tha king Nebuchadnezzar ur father, tha king, I say, ur father, made master of tha magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, N soothsayers;

Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, N knowledge, N understanding, interpreting of dreams, N shewing of hard sentences, N dissolving of doubts, were found in tha same Daniel, whom tha king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, N he will show tha interpretation.
Then was Daniel brought in before tha king. N tha king spoke N said 2 Daniel, r u dat Daniel, which art of tha children of tha captivity of Judah, whom tha king my father brought out of Jewry?
I have even heard of u, dat tha spirit of tha gods is in u, N dat light N understanding N excellent wisdom is found in u.

N now tha wise men, tha astrologers, have been brought in before me, dat dey should read dis writing, N make known 2 me tha interpretation of it: but dey could not show tha interpretation of tha thing:

N I have heard of u, dat u can make interpretations, N dissolve doubts: now if u can read tha writing, N make known 2 me tha interpretation of it, u will be clothed wit scarlet, N have a chain of gold about ur neck, N will be tha third ruler in tha kingdom.
Then Daniel answered before tha king, Let ur gifts be 2 urself, N give ur rewards 2 another; yet I will read tha writing 2 tha king, N make known 2 him tha interpretation.
O u king, tha most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar ur father a kingdom, N majesty, N glory, N honour:

N 4 tha majesty dat he gave him, all people, nations, N languages, trembled N feared before him: whom he would he killed; N whom he would he kept alive; N whom he would he set up; N whom he would he put down.
But when his heart was lifted up, N his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, N dey took his glory from him:

N he was driven from tha sons of men; N his heart was made like tha beasts, N his livin was wit tha wild asses: dey fed him wit grass like oxen, N his body was wet wit tha dew of heaven; till he knew dat tha most high God ruled in tha kingdom of men, N dat he appointeth over it whoever he will.
N u his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled thine heart, though u knew all dis;

But have lifted up urself against tha Lord of heaven; N dey have brought tha vessels of his house before u, N u, N ur lords, ur wives, N ur concubines, have drunk wine in ’em; N u have praised tha gods of silver, N gold, of brass, iron, wood, N stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: N tha God in whose hand ur breath is, N whose r all ur ways, have u not glorified:
Then was tha part of tha hand sent from him; N dis writing was written.
N dis is tha writing dat was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
Dis is tha interpretation of tha thing: MENE; God has numbered ur kingdom, N finished it.
TEKEL; u r weighed in tha balances, N art found wantin.
PERES; ur kingdom is divided, N given 2 tha Medes N Persians.
Then commanded Belshazzar, N dey clothed Daniel wit scarlet, N put a chain of gold about his neck, N made a proclamation concerning him, dat he should be tha third ruler in tha kingdom.
In dat night was Belshazzar tha king of tha Chaldeans killed.
N Darius tha Median took tha kingdom, bein about threescore N two years old.

6.text: It pleased Darius 2 set over tha kingdom an hundred N twenty princes, which should be over tha whole kingdom;
N over dese three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: dat tha princes might give accounts 2 ’em, N tha king should have no damage.
